name: hivemind
description: Shared, versioned knowledge graph + artifact store + tool registry for an agent fleet. Connects to a self-hosted Hivemind server over MCP (HTTP) and adds a skill that teaches agents to use it.

server_url.title: Hivemind project URL
server_url.description: Full project base URL, including the project path, e.g. http://<server-host>:8787/p/default (LAN/Tailscale address of your Hivemind server).

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for this project (from the server's tokens.json / `hivemind-admin mint-token`).
